statement: A holder of cosec:approve on the document in the platform tenant is the trust root: its own changes are not analyzed and need no second person, unless four-eyes is on, when what the analysis cannot prove needs another holder, a platform principal too. A tenant principal holding cosec:approve is not the trust root: its own changes are analyzed (RC1-10). A workload is never the trust root: a principal whose credential declares itself a workload's (an API key's and a service's own identity are by construction, IDN-34), one with no credential, or one CoSec's API key authenticator proved (IDN-44).
guards: control:ApprovalB2Test#a tenant approver's own change is analyzed, and it approves others' - RC1-10
control:ControlAuthorizationTest#the trust root publishes alone unless four-eyes is on
control:ApprovalB2Test#under four-eyes a platform principal's change needs a platform approver
control:ApprovalB2Test#an API key is never the trust root - review M2
control:ApprovalB2Test#a service's own identity is never the trust root - IDN-34
